reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-04 owns parallel rendered byte/attribute allocations plus ANSI xbuffers; conversion separately returns an allocated chpos map. forw/back consume those owners through rendering APIs.
owner_creation.invariant: Rendered bytes, attributes and source maps have distinct owners.
limitations: The source map is not owned by an offset into linebuf.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-04 forw_raw_line_len returns a borrowed linebuf address and length, while cvt_text walks raw source/destination/map cursors supplied by callers.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A returned line borrow must not survive owner replacement.
limitations: Length arguments do not encode a Rust borrow or source generation.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-04 overlay_header calls forw_line and put_line directly for each header row; conversion synchronously creates, steps and releases ANSI state rather than retaining a callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Rendering callees must preserve active conversion owner contracts.
limitations: Direct calls can still mutate shared rendering globals.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-04 expand_linebuf frees both old arrays before publishing replacement pointers; prewind clears logical content and saved rendering state even without moving the allocation.
invalidation.invariant: Old pointers and old logical content expire at different transitions.
limitations: No generation token accompanies a borrowed raw line.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-04 stages both grown arrays before changing linebuf, but cvt_length still uses wrapping sizing and cvt_text writes narrowed source offsets incrementally.
mutation_commit.invariant: Successful allocation staging does not prove numeric capacity bounds.
limitations: The c_int source map requires a separate representability contract.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-04 frees replaced line arrays in expand_linebuf and pairs ansi_start allocation with ansi_done free. A returned chpos map remains the caller allocation responsibility.
release_pair.invariant: Temporary ANSI state and persistent render arrays use separate release paths.
limitations: This review does not infer an exit-time free for every retained global buffer.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-04 failed dual-array growth frees whichever candidate succeeded, retains old arrays and returns failure. Raw-line scanning then returns a bounded partial line rather than a typed complete-read result.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure must preserve old storage while reporting partial content honestly.
limitations: Partial-line behavior is not a fresh compatibility campaign result.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-04 forw/back poll sigs around rendering, but linebuf and source-map cursors still rely on serialized use of mutable application state. M0-MEM-001 stays open for that owner contract.
signals_handoff.invariant: Polling alone does not create exclusive rendering ownership.
limitations: No specific handler-to-linebuf replacement route is established here.
